reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and existing bank lookup and import helpers, but Fintegra copies the linking and download workflows and replacement copies the local unlink reset.

duplication.why: The diff adds three substantial duplicated blocks: the provider linking workflow, transaction downloader, and account link-field reset.

placement.why: Provider handling stays in the established account and sync modules, but an assertion helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: The edits remain focused on the requested linking rules and Fintegra support, including the client mappings required by the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking rules help maintenance, but duplicated provider workflows and a mutating assertion obscure responsibilities and create multiple places to update shared behavior.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked duplicates the local reset owned by unlinkAccount; extracting that reset would allow replacement to reuse it without triggering provider disconnection.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra workflows and account reset are direct, recognizable copies rather than duplication hidden through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and branches for closed-target validation and replacement, evolving from a duplicate-link assertion into validation plus unlink mutation; all six linking handlers still call it.
